_comment: Data-driven system definitions for the ROM import wizard. ROMs are copied to Assets/<platformId>/common on the SD card (verified from Analogue developer docs: https://www.analogue.co/developer/docs/directories-and-sd-folder-structure). IMPORTANT: platformId is defined by each individual openFPGA core's platform definition, NOT globally standardised by Analogue. The values below match the most widely used community cores at time of writing; if you use a different core, confirm its platformId and edit this file - no code change required. suggestedCore is informational only; this tool does not download cores (see issue #13).

systems.notes: ROMs go to Assets/gb/common.
ROMs go to Assets/gbc/common.
ROMs go to Assets/gba/common. Some GBA cores can use an optional BIOS; not required and not copied by default.
ROMs go to Assets/nes/common.
ROMs go to Assets/snes/common.
ROMs go to Assets/genesis/common. The .bin extension is ambiguous (also used by other systems); confirm before bulk-copying a mixed folder.
ROMs go to Assets/sms/common.
ROMs go to Assets/gg/common.
HuCard ROMs go to Assets/pce/common. CD-based games need additional setup not covered by the MVP.

Neo Geo games are FOLDERS (DarkSoft format: srom/prom/crom0/m1rom/vroma0), one per game, copied to Assets/ng/common/<game>/. The Mazamars312 core ships a launch .json per supported game (in Assets/ng/Mazamars312.NeoGeo) and the folder name must match that json's data_path (e.g. mslug4). Point the ROM step at the folder CONTAINING your converted game folders. Also required in Assets/ng/common: uni-bios_4_0.rom, 000-lo.lo and sfix.sfix (upload them from the card overview). Convert a romset you own; this tool never downloads ROMs or BIOS.

systems.suggestedCore: jotego jtngp (Neo Geo Pocket / Color, Patreon beta)
systems.notes: Neo Geo Pocket / Color runs on jotego's jtngp core (platform-id jtngp). ROMs go to Assets/jtngp/common and load via the core's runtime file browser (the Cartridge slot is unrestricted). jtngp is Patreon-distributed (https://www.patreon.com/jotego) and not publicly downloadable - install the zip you obtained via 'Install a core you supply' on the cores step. The core's ngp.rom/ngpc.rom boot files ship with it. If your core declares a different platform-id, its own ROM row appears automatically after install.
